manipulators.description: Change caps_lock to command+control+option+shift.

rules.description: Home-row modifiers: left F/D/S/A, right J/K/L/semicolon; G/H left/right Hyper; tap-then-hold to repeat (built-in keyboard only)

manipulators.description: Tap then hold j to repeat
Tap j; hold for right_command
Tap then hold k to repeat
Tap k; hold for right_option
Tap then hold l to repeat
Tap l; hold for right_control
Tap then hold semicolon to repeat
Tap semicolon; hold for right_shift
Tap then hold f to repeat
Tap f; hold for left_command
Tap then hold d to repeat
Tap d; hold for left_option
Tap then hold s to repeat
Tap s; hold for left_control
Tap then hold a to repeat
Tap a; hold for left_shift
Tap then hold g to repeat
Tap g; hold for left Hyper (Command+Option+Control+Shift)
Tap then hold h to repeat
Tap h; hold for right Hyper (Command+Option+Control+Shift)

rules.description: Change caps_lock to control if pressed with other keys, to escape if pressed alone.
Change caps_lock to left_control if pressed with other keys, change caps_lock to escape if pressed alone.
Caps Lock to Escape (built-in keyboard only)
